name: Self-Calibration via Absolute Dual Quadric
definition: A method to recover metric reconstruction (camera intrinsics and 3D structure) from projective reconstruction by imposing constraints on the absolute dual quadric Ω*.
summary: Self-Calibration via Absolute Dual Quadric upgrades projective reconstructions to metric ones by solving for the invariant absolute dual quadric, deriving camera intrinsics solely from scene geometry without calibration targets.
